obligation.summary: High-risk AI systems must be designed to allow deployers to interpret and use output appropriately.

evidence_text: Instructions for Use v2.0 (published 2026-07-20): includes the system's intended purpose, performance characteristics and known limitations, required human oversight measures, expected input data specifications, and a named point of contact for deployer questions. Distributed to all deployers at onboarding and versioned alongside each model release.
